description: This file defines the class ConditionalDataBarExtension, which provides methods and properties related to the styling of data bars in conditional formatting within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes attributes and functions to get and set various styling options such as length, colors, direction, and border properties.

classes.name: ConditionalDataBarExtension
classes.description: A class that manages styling attributes for data bars in conditional formatting.

methods.name: getXmlAttributes
methods.description: Returns an array of XML attributes representing the internal style properties related to data bar configuration.

methods.name: getXmlElements
methods.description: Returns an array of XML elements for colors and axis color configuration.

methods.name: getMinLength
methods.description: Getter for the minimum length of the data bar.

methods.name: setMinLength
methods.description: Setter for the minimum length of the data bar.

methods.name: getMaxLength
methods.description: Getter for the maximum length of the data bar.

methods.name: setMaxLength
methods.description: Setter for the maximum length of the data bar.

methods.name: getBorder
methods.description: Getter for the border property.

methods.name: setBorder
methods.description: Setter for the border property.

methods.name: getGradient
methods.description: Getter for the gradient property.

methods.name: setGradient
methods.description: Setter for the gradient property.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Getter for the direction property.

methods.name: setDirection
methods.description: Setter for the direction property.

methods.name: getNegativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive
methods.description: Getter for the negative bar border color flag.

methods.name: setNegativeBarBorderColorSameAsPositive
methods.description: Setter for the negative bar border color flag.

methods.name: getAxisPosition
methods.description: Getter for the axis position property.

methods.name: setAxisPosition
methods.description: Setter for the axis position property.

methods.name: getMaximumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Getter for the maximum value object for conditional formatting.

methods.name: setMaximumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Setter for the maximum value object for conditional formatting.

methods.name: getMinimumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Getter for the minimum value object for conditional formatting.

methods.name: setMinimumConditionalFormatValueObject
methods.description: Setter for the minimum value object for conditional formatting.

methods.name: getBorderColor
methods.description: Getter for the border color.

methods.name: setBorderColor
methods.description: Setter for the border color.

methods.name: getNegativeFillColor
methods.description: Getter for the negative fill color.

methods.name: setNegativeFillColor
methods.description: Setter for the negative fill color.

methods.name: getNegativeBorderColor
methods.description: Getter for the negative border color.

methods.name: setNegativeBorderColor
methods.description: Setter for the negative border color.

methods.name: getAxisColor
methods.description: Getter for the axis color array.

methods.name: setAxisColor
methods.description: Setter for the axis color array, allowing rgb, theme, and tint customization.
